title: Fetzi’s AD – Shoji Detail Addon
description: This resource pack provides a small, personal adjustment to the shoji wall textures in Fetzi’s Asian Decoration, adding clearer structural separation and depth to better support building detailed walls using only shoji blocks.
body:
![shoji-banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/futonid/resources/0d75c94525f6d0e96d6aa5d2e984eb6ef835589f/shoji-banner.png)

[![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-Fetzi's%20AD-gray?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white&logoSize=auto&label=modrinth&labelColor=f16436&cacheSeconds=3600) ](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fetzis-asian-decoration)       [![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-notes-gray?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white&logoSize=auto&label=github&labelColor=blue&cacheSeconds=3600) ](https://github.com/futonid/mc-custom-uv-break-overlay)         [![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-Fetzi's%20AD-gray?style=for-the-badge&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white&logoSize=auto&label=modrinth&labelColor=1bd96a&cacheSeconds=3600) ](https://modrinth.com/mod/fetzis-asian-decoration)        [![Static Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-support-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=buymeacoffee&logoColor=white&logoSize=auto&label=quality&color=b5ffe5&cacheSeconds=3600) ](https://buymeacoffee.com/utamiid)

``` I really enjoy using Fetzi’s Asian Decoration mod, which adds a wide range of beautiful content to the game. To better suit my own building style, I made a small personal revision to the shoji panels, focusing on clearer structural separation and added 3D depth. This allows walls to be built using only shoji blocks. ``` > This resource pack is not standalone and requires [Fetzi's Asian Decoration](https://modrinth.com/mod/fetzis-asian-decoration) mod. > Special thanks to [Fetzi](https://modrinth.com/user/Fetzi) for kindly allowing me to share this personal adjustment with the community. ---
